# Reused prompt excerpts

These short excerpts are copied verbatim from the pinned MIT-licensed prompt files below. They are provenance records; the Novel workflow does not load an upstream pattern catalog. The Chinese prompts translate or adapt these selected rules and add separately identified Novel-specific fiction constraints. Preserve this file, NOTICE.md and both LICENSE files when redistributing this pack.

## 1. blader/humanizer: How to work, step 3

Source: https://github.com/blader/humanizer/blob/225a6f39ac85f76ee48dbad772ea4abe4ed6c9d8/SKILL.md

> Ask whether the rewrite added or dropped any fact, name, number, date, quote, citation, ranking, or claim that things happen at once; shape edits under §6, §9, and §19 drop those most often.

## 2. blader/humanizer: Voice

Source: https://github.com/blader/humanizer/blob/225a6f39ac85f76ee48dbad772ea4abe4ed6c9d8/SKILL.md

> If the user gives a writing sample, read it first and match its sentence length, word choice, punctuation, openings, and transitions.

## 3. op7418/Humanizer-zh: 编辑约束与优先级, 3

Source: https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh/blob/f4518a8eab97b8bfebc66a89d34320a89bef6930/SKILL.md

> 有样本时借鉴句长、用词、标点和叙述习惯，不把样本中的经历、数据或立场移入目标文本。没有样本时保留输入的语域。

## 4. op7418/Humanizer-zh: 编辑约束与优先级, 4

Source: https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh/blob/f4518a8eab97b8bfebc66a89d34320a89bef6930/SKILL.md

> 模式清单是检查线索，不是词语黑名单；没有问题的段落可以原样保留。

## 5. op7418/Humanizer-zh: 文体与作者声音

Source: https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh/blob/f4518a8eab97b8bfebc66a89d34320a89bef6930/SKILL.md

> 不要为追求短句把连贯文章拆成要点提纲，也不要为了变化句长硬拆或合并。

## 6. op7418/Humanizer-zh: 工作流程, 3

Source: https://github.com/op7418/Humanizer-zh/blob/f4518a8eab97b8bfebc66a89d34320a89bef6930/SKILL.md

> 对照原文检查改写：有没有新增、遗漏或强化主张；施事者、时间、条件、范围、否定与归因是否一致。
